annotations.title: Fast track and intermediate track timetable calculator (PD 28, CPR Part 28)

description: Works out the standard timetable after allocation to the fast track or the intermediate track in England and Wales: the PD 28 para 9.5 typical periods from the notice of allocation (disclosure, witness statements, experts' reports, pre-trial checklists, trial within 30 weeks), the time to apply to set aside or vary the order, agreed directions before a case management conference, the pre-trial checklist (N170), notice of trial, the trial fee (fee 2.1), the trial bundle (CPR 39.5), skeleton arguments, Precedent U or the N260 statement of costs, written questions to experts, and the Damages Claims Portal and noise-induced hearing loss variants. Each date says whether it is a typical period, a rule, the standard order or your own order, and which rest on our reading. The court's own order governs every date.

allocationDate.description: The date of the notice of allocation, or of the directions order (YYYY-MM-DD).

cmcDate.description: "intermediate": the date of any case management conference (YYYY-MM-DD).

costs.description: Whether costs are fixed, for the statement of costs step (default unsure): "unsure" (Not sure: show both), "fixed" (Fixed recoverable costs (CPR 45 Section VI, VII or VIII)), "notFixed" (Not fixed (for example a housing disrepair claim)).

dcp.description: The claim is in the Damages Claims Portal (PD 51ZB).

nihl.description: "fast": a noise-induced hearing loss claim, with its own standard directions (CPR 28.9).

noticeDate.description: Where the order did not fix the trial date or window: the date the court first gave notice of it, for the trial fee (YYYY-MM-DD).

ptcDate.description: The date the order gives for filing pre-trial checklists (YYYY-MM-DD).

readinessDate.description: "fast" in the portal: the date of the court's notice to complete the trial readiness certificate (YYYY-MM-DD).

reportDate.description: The date an expert's report was served, for written questions to the expert (YYYY-MM-DD).

servedDate.description: The date the order was served, if later than its date (YYYY-MM-DD).

track.description: The track (default fast). The multi-track and the small claims track are not covered: "fast" (Fast track), "intermediate" (Intermediate track).

trialDate.description: The date the trial is listed for, once the notice of trial is sent (YYYY-MM-DD).

windowEnd.description: The last day of the trial window (leave out for a fixed trial date) (YYYY-MM-DD).

windowStart.description: The trial date, or the first day of the trial window (YYYY-MM-DD).
